notes.title: Version 1.4.0: Maid's Life
notes.notes:
The fourth and (probably) the final content update is here! It's time to visit the Duskheart Family once more! ːduskheartː

This update further expands the epilogue as well as the side story about Nadya's [strike]daily[/strike] nightly life. In other words, the new things are as follows:

Epilogic Episode 5
Nadya's Nightlife Episode 4

These two episodes are strongly related to each other, and together they make up a story of about 5000 words. There are new event graphics, of course, and two new achievements for completing the Epilogue and Nadya's Nightlife.

It is also worth mentioning that during the story Sarah receives the letter that her mother Serena sent her in Succubus Research Diary...


How to access the new content?

To unlock Nadya's Nightlife Episode 4, you have to play through the previously added content first:

Nadya's Nightlife Episodes 1-3
Epilogic Episodes 1-4

You can access Epilogic Episode 5 once you have played Nadya's Nightlife Episode 4.

Note: If you have already played through all the previous content, you can access Nadya's Nightlife Episode 4 right away. This should work even if you're reinstalling the game (unless you have manually deleted the save data ːsteamfacepalmː).


Oh, and perhaps it's not yet too late to say this: Happy New Year! ːduskheartː

notes.title: Version 1.3.1
notes.notes: The hunt for grammatical errors continues... after a rather long break. This is a small update that makes the game 0.05% more grammatically correct.

notes.title: Version 1.3.0: Nadya's Nightlife
notes.notes:
The third content update adds a side story that follows the nightly adventures of the housemaid Nadya! For one reason or another, Nadya often finds herself in the bedrooms of her fellow maids and the mistress of the house...

Nadya's Nightlife is split into three episodes that will be unlocked at certain points of the main story.

If you have already played Lily's Handmaid and reached any of the four endings, you'll find all three episodes available in the main menu.

There's a new screenshot on the store page, showing a glimpse into one of the nightly adventures of Nadya!

notes.title: Version 1.2.1
notes.notes: A small update that corrects a couple of dozen grammatical errors and fixes a minor bug that sometimes caused an in-game menu not display properly.

notes.title: Version 1.2.0: Epilogic Episodes 3 & 4
notes.notes:
This update completes the epilogue by adding episodes 3 and 4 to it. There's a sample screenshot of the new event graphics on the store page.

Additionally, the user interface has been updated to have new shortcuts to the episode selection screen: 1) after Lily ending and 2) at the end of each Epilogic Episode.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0: Epilogic Episodes 1 & 2
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.0 adds an epilogue to the game that is available in the main menu after reaching the "Lily Ending." There's a sample screenshot of the new event graphics on the store page.

The epilogue will consist of a total of four "Epilogic Episodes," two of which are released in this update. Episodes 3 and 4 are currently in development and will be released in late May or early June.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.notes: A small update that fixes a handful of typos and grammatical errors that weren't caught during the beta testing.

notes.title: Version 1.0.0
notes.notes: Lily's Handmaid is now out of beta. As announced before, it will be released tomorrow.

notes.title: Release date set to 24th of April
notes.notes:
With all but the final chapter of the story finished, Lily's Handmaid nears its completion. The release date is set to 24th of April, a little less than six weeks from now.

Curators can get earlier access to the game on request. If you are interested in reviewing a pre-release build, please send a message via Steam or to the support email.
